name: Sync Leads (create/update)
summary: Creates new lead records, updates existing ones, or both. Each row is one person; Marketo matches them to existing leads using the lookup field (default: email).
whenToUse: When you have lead data (from a spreadsheet, form, or another system) and want to create or update people in Marketo. Up to 300 records per call.

fixed.name: action
fixed.label: Action
fixed.hint: What to do for each row. Leave on the default unless you have a reason.

fixed.name: lookupField
fixed.label: Match existing leads by
fixed.hint: The field used to find the existing lead to update. Default is email. You can also use another field API name, or a combination like firstName+lastName+email.

response.description: One status per row: created / updated / failed, with a reason when it failed.

notes: Include an email in each row whenever possible — it's what makes new rows match existing people instead of creating duplicates.
Company fields can't be set with this call — Marketo has a separate Companies API for those.
Row order in the response matches the order you sent.
